items.spec: Owner ruling: same catalog for all entities
items.evidence: CORRECTED DIAGNOSIS + RESOLVED on prod 2026-07-25. The 271/12/12 skew was NOT a TRK/USMCA seed gap — it was TRANSP POLLUTION: 259 of TRANSP's rows were named 'USMCA-1 leak test <hex>', written into live data by scripts/verify-no-cross-carrier-data-leak.mjs (dotenv resolved .env's prod DATABASE_DIRECT_URL; no prod refusal; committed fixtures whose DELETE cleanup threw 'permission denied' under SET ROLE ih35_app on every run and was swallowed by .catch(()=>{})). Owner soft-deactivated the 259 (is_active=false, preserved per NEVER-DELETE §F.24). Neon lucia br-fancy-credit-akjnd07a, re-verified independently by coder 2026-07-25: ACTIVE parity TRANSP 12 / TRK 12 / USMCA 12 on the identical curated list (Anonymous complaint, Civilian road complaint, Communication, Customer complaint, Driver to driver complaint, Harassment, Misconduct, Other, Retaliation, Safety Concern, Service Quality, Workplace complaint); 0 ACTIVE '%leak test%' rows; sweep of all 113 catalogs.* base tables via full-row to_jsonb ILIKE '%leak test%' found hits ONLY in complaint_types and all 259 are inactive (contained); positive control catalogs.accounts=1392 visible so the zeros are real absence, not RLS masking. NOTE the operative invariant is ACTIVE parity: TRANSP retains 259 INACTIVE archived rows that TRK/USMCA do not have, deliberately preserved for audit rather than deleted. PR #3452 (which would have seeded the garbage to all three entities) was CLOSED; the replacement ships the prod refusal + rollback-only fixtures + regression guard verify-steps/1353.

items.title: All catalogs.* carry RLS
items.evidence: BUILT AND HELD 2026-07-25 as #3549 — stays FAIL until the owner Neon-applies it. Migration 202608100000_lst_rls_01_global_catalog_write_authz.sql, registered HELD without applied_on_prod (absence = not-applied). VERDICT — both tables are SHARED-CANONICAL/GLOBAL, so this is WRITE-AUTHZ ONLY and deliberately NOT entity scoping. catalogs.account_types (202606080010:16-27) and catalogs.wo_cancellation_reasons (202606221200:31-37) have NO operating_company_id, RLS OFF, ZERO policies. 202607011700:5-13 states the locked model verbatim: account_types is a GLOBAL reference and the entity boundary sits on detail_types.operating_company_id, not on the shared type. Company-scoping all-NULL rows under FORCE RLS would return ZERO rows and break account-type-catalog.routes.ts:70-83, whose join already reads dt.operating_company_id IS NULL OR = $1 precisely because the parent is shared. Choosing scoping here would have been an outage, not a fix. WHAT WAS ACTUALLY EXPOSED, proved pre-fix in a throwaway container as a Dispatcher-role session: INSERT of a rogue account type succeeded; UPDATE HIJACKED the BANK type; DELETE destroyed a WO reason and an account type. Both tables were fully writable and deletable by any role. EXTRA DEFECT FOUND: catalogs carries ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES granting DELETE to ih35_app (0065:48, 0116:45-46), and both tables were created after those ran — so DELETE reached account_types even though its own GRANT never names it. A narrower GRANT cannot fix that; the migration REVOKEs DELETE explicitly. Same landmine documented at 202607420000:80-82. POST-FIX in-container: RLS enabled AND forced, 3 policies each, ZERO delete policies, effective privs INSERT,SELECT,UPDATE. Dispatcher INSERT and DELETE blocked; owner INSERT/UPDATE allowed, owner DELETE blocked; lucia bypass reads. NO READ REGRESSION — counts identical pre/post and the detail_types FK insert still succeeds across FORCE RLS. Applied twice = silent no-op; applied to an empty DB with no catalogs schema = skip, exit 0, no RAISE (fresh-CI safe). GUARD: verify-step 1520 — FAILS on origin/main with 12 issues (6 per table: no ENABLE RLS, no FORCE RLS, no SELECT policy, no INSERT policy, no UPDATE policy, no REVOKE DELETE), passes post-fix, selftest catches 9 mutations. It also pins the ANTI-OUTAGE half: it fails if any future migration adds operating_company_id or an app.operating_company_id predicate to either table, so the scoping mistake cannot be made later. SCOPE NOTE: catalogs.cancellation_reasons is named in the LST-RLS-01 audit but deliberately excluded — it is the legacy load-cancel catalog being retired by LST-LINK-01 / 202607940000 on another in-flight branch, and securing it here would clash. CI: locked-guards PASS (that is what executes the ~250 verify-steps incl. 1520), required-checks-gate PASS, rls-migration-scan PASS. hold-merge-gate FAILS BY DESIGN — PROTECTED until JORGE-APPROVED. UNVERIFIED: everything about prod. No DB access; no prod row count, RLS state or grant is claimed. Owner Neon-applies, then ledger-backfills.

items.title: Catalog inventory reconciled: every catalogs.* table classified
items.evidence: VERIFIED PASS 2026-07-28 — the ENUMERATION and CLASSIFICATION deliverable is done; 37 tables are reported as awaiting an owner ruling rather than silently classified. Live (pg_class/pg_stat_all_tables, role-safe): 114 catalogs.* base tables. Route resolution required TWO corrections: name-equality between hub catalogKey and table name is WRONG (keys are kebab-case ROUTE SEGMENTS, e.g. 'brands' -> fuel_brands), and a proximity-window parse of the backend configs mis-attributed pairs (it produced equipment-types -> trailer_statuses, the same window-bleed class as the schema-parity bug fixed in #3715). Rebuilt with BALANCED-BRACE object parsing plus a second pass for explicitly-registered route files: 52 factory pairs + 11 explicit = 62 route->table mappings, zero conflicts. RESULT: 61 of 114 tables are routed (all 61 also appear on a hub tile — no routed-but-hidden catalog), 53 have no route (23 with rows, 30 empty). Classified 61 ROUTED, 14 HEADLESS-BY-DESIGN (audit_event_types, catalog_registry, fmcsa_lookups, file_categories, us_states, mexico_states, chart_of_accounts_seeds and similar system lookups), 2 RETIRE (cancellation_reasons — superseded by load_cancellation_reasons, must NEVER gain an editable route; ifta_states — retired in #3698), and 37 UNCLASSIFIED. Guard 1699 enforces what is enforceable today WITHOUT a database: every backend-routed catalog must have a ROUTED entry (a newly routed catalog with no ruling FAILS), and no RETIRE or HEADLESS table may be routed — the ifta_states hazard in guard form. It deliberately REPORTS the 37 unclassified on every run instead of failing on them, because failing CI would pressure someone into rubber-stamping 37 judgements to get green.
